agent_explanation: High-speed oblique circle-circle collision creates energy and momentum. Initial x-momentum ~-229.5 becomes ~+798.9 and y-momentum 0 becomes ~-402, with energy 3712->23651J in one step (6 substeps) and zero controller work, with bodies ending overlapped (gap -0.00088). Likely the impulse/positional-correction path over-applies (e.g. repeated or mass-swapped normal impulse, plus normal with large y-component from dy=0.7 offset) at high closing speed (~58 m/s) and large mass ratio (~16.6:1), injecting momentum along the contact normal into the heavy body (vx -16.3->+45.75, vy 0->-24.29) instead of conserving it.
